To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the local micro‐environ‐ ment of the adult CNS plays a crucial role in fate choice of neural stem cells.
NG2 cells in culture with hippocampal slices differentiate into mature oligodendroglia, but not into neurons or astrocytes.

NG2 progenitors in the hippocampus are a heterogeneous population of cells that can be induced to differentiate into neurons and astrocytes, but not oligodendroglia, in response to local cues in the tissue environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of local micro-environment on the fate decision of NG2 progenitors, which are the major source of new oligodendroglia in the adult brain.
the role of the local environment in determining the fate of NG2 progenitor cells.
the effects of the local microenvironment of the adult CNS on fate decisions of NG2 cells, with a special emphasis on the role of hippocampal environment on NG2 cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NG2 progenitors in adult brain are heterogeneous, and the heterogeneity may reflect their different developmental stages and/or different functional states.
NG2 progenitors are able to differentiate into mature oligodendroglia in vitro, but only in the presence of the local microenvironment.
the hippocampus has an effect on the differentiation and maturation, but not on the proliferation of NG2 cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hippocampus has a strong effect on the differentiation of NG2 cells.
NG2 precursor cells are not only able to proliferate but also able to differentiate and mature in the presence of the local microenvironment.
NG2 progenitors can respond to the local micro-environment and differentiate into oligodendroglia, astrocyte, and neurons in a time and cell density-dependent manner.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NG2 progenitor cells can be directed towards oligodendroglial fate in a tissue specific manner.

the microenvironment is crucial in the fate decision of NG2 progenitors, as it can induce them to differentiate into oligodendroglia, or astrocytes, and that this decision can be modulated by the presence of a specific extracellular matrix protein.
the local environment of the adult hippocampus is permissive for oligodendroglial differentiation and maturation.
